Technical SEO.title: Publishers Noticing Google News Tab Content Disappearing
Technical SEO.summary: Publishers report that content being crawled and indexed in Google Search is nonetheless missing from the News tab, sometimes appearing much later. The behavior appears random and has been replicated by Search Engine Roundtable.

Technical SEO.title: Google Says Ranking Recovery Takes Months After SEO Issues Are Fixed
Technical SEO.summary: Google has explained that fixing the root cause of a ranking drop does not guarantee a quick rankings recovery, with the process typically taking months. This has direct implications for enterprise SEO teams managing post-penalty or post-update remediation timelines.

Technical SEO.title: Should I Block AI Crawlers At Robots.txt Or Server Level?
Technical SEO.summary: The article breaks down the difference between using robots.txt versus WAF, CDN, or server-level controls to block AI crawlers, noting that robots.txt relies on bot compliance while server-level enforcement is definitive. This is directly actionable for enterprise technical SEO teams managing crawl policy.

Technical SEO.title: How To Build Site Authority and Multi-Channel Relevance in the Age of AI
Technical SEO.summary: Moz outlines strategies for building site authority in an AI-driven search environment, covering off-site signals, LLM visibility, and content ROI optimization. The focus on multi-channel relevance makes it applicable to enterprise brands managing cross-property SEO.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Rapid AI Changes Mean GEO Is a Weekly Job Now
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: MarTech argues that because AI-generated answers change frequently, PR, SEO, and content teams need a shared, continuously updated view of which buyer questions are being asked, which sources are cited, and what shifts week over week. This reframes GEO as an ongoing operational discipline rather than a one-time optimization.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Product Pages Get 24% Of AI Citations, Reddit and YouTube 4%
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A citation study by Ten Speed found that product pages account for 24% of AI citations for B2B buyers, while Reddit and YouTube together account for only 4%. The findings were verified through a rigorous fact-checking process and have direct implications for content prioritization in AI-answer surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: When AI Has Nothing On Your Company, It Describes Someone Else
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article warns that when AI models lack sufficient information about a brand, they may substitute a competitor's description, and that simply publishing more content will not fix the problem due to popularity bias in retrieval systems. This is a critical brand-visibility risk for enterprise teams operating in AI search.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google loses the ad monopoly case, but keeps the monopoly
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A federal judge ruled that Google illegally monopolized key ad-tech markets but rejected the remedy that could have structurally reshaped those markets, meaning Google retains its dominant position. Enterprise teams should monitor whether this affects search ad pricing or inventory dynamics.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Mode Gemini 3.8 Flash Not Link or Citation Friendly
AI Search / GEO.summary: Early testing of Google AI Mode running Gemini 3.8 Flash shows the model is less likely to cite or link to sources than previous AI Mode versions. For enterprise brands investing in GEO and AI citation strategies, this represents a significant shift in referral traffic potential from Google AI Mode.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Mode Prices Differ From Product Carousel For Same Items
AI Search / GEO.summary: Research finds that Google AI Mode rarely surfaces the same products as the standard results carousel and frequently shows a different seller even when the same item appears in both. This has direct implications for travel and e-commerce brands tracking their visibility across Google's AI and traditional surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google's New Weather AI In Search Continues Shift Away From 10 Blue Links
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google's latest Search integration delivers weather information through an AI-powered experience, continuing a broader pattern of users completing tasks without clicking traditional search results. This trend accelerates zero-click risk for informational content across enterprise and travel verticals.

AI Search / GEO.title: AI SEO and GEO Tools: What Brands Need as the EU Officially Classifies ChatGPT as a Search Engine
AI Search / GEO.summary: The EU's official classification of ChatGPT as a search engine creates new regulatory and strategic implications for brands managing GEO and AI search visibility. The announcement signals that AI-answer platforms are now subject to the same regulatory scrutiny as traditional search engines in Europe.
